_doc: Stages (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md 4.1): region stage key -> ordered maps with one boss and pool rule each, map_seconds (boss delay from map entry), round duration (s), pacing keyframes, bursts, elites. Keyframe numbers (rate = mobs/s, max_alive, hp and speed multipliers) interpolate linearly in time between keyframes; the pool (mob id -> weight) is the one of the last keyframe at or before t. Bursts: every `every` s from `first`, a ring of count_min..count_max mobs (growing with time) around the view, allowed past max_alive up to `hard_cap`. Elites: every `every` s from `first`, one mob of the current pool with hp_mult x HP, exp_mult x EXP and damage_mult x mitigated damage. spawn: overrides of balance.json spawn for this region. exp_mult: EXP multiplier of this stage. note: a line shown on the stage card. region and continent (both required, tier C owner choice #221): the town the player sees as the stage name and the small line above or beside it; they replace the WZ map and street names everywhere. original_life is the map's own spawn list (shown on the stage card). Potions are unlimited on per-kind cooldowns; no potion drops exist (spec #237). Boss summon and revive mob ids are not listed here: they come from the bosses' canonical MobSkill 200 and info/revive data (StageRoster). All numbers tier C (ours).
_progression: Tier C (ADR 0007, owner request 2026-10-30; spec #447): the ordered region keys of the game, in the order a v83 character levelled. A character starts with the first one open; clearing a region (its last map's boss dead, round CLEARED) opens the next (CharacterSnapshot.cleared_regions, SceneFlow.unlocked_stages). Replaces the run tiers of spec #32 and the owner region lists of spec #241 (Perion and Kerning City added by spec #253). Every key must exist in `stages`, appear once and carry a drop_band (DataRepo.progression_errors). A stage outside the list stays loadable for --run/--stage tools only.
_drop_band: Tier C (ADR 0006 #292 per tier, ADR 0007 / spec #447 per region; owner call): each stage's `drop_band` is the [min, max] reqLevel its equipment drops come from, rising along the progression. Ordinary drops pick inside the band, bosses from its top third (equipment_drops.json boss_top_parts). The band replaces the character-level window: a round always starts at Lv1. A stage without one drops from any reqLevel (EquipmentDrops.band_of).

tier C: contact450 and slam300 receive separate survivor scales calibrated against actual training buildHP; canonical attack values unchanged

henesys._balance29: Tier C: historical coarse #29 pass for the vanilla v83 Beginner (5 MP, one Three Snails shell at canonical MP): a sword-paced opening of a few mobs and generous HP drops until 4:00, no elites before 4:00 or bursts before 5:00, and 2.5x stage EXP so the bot reaches Magician near 4:40. Superseded by the #30 C46 calibration below; Tree stage data unchanged.
henesys._balance30: Tier C: coarse C46 stage data from #30 (training seeds 1..60 and 2026, measured with card weights 86/8/3.5/1.7/0.8; GAME_DESIGN 4.2). Retains v83 opening, later HP pressure/support and late ordinary MP taper. Not re-tuned for the restored spec card odds; tuning waits for the dedicated balance pass.
henesys._post_duration_slope: Tier C: after the last keyframe, continue its rate/max_alive/HP/speed slopes, the burst-size slope and (via the rate ratio) the elite frequency at one quarter pace until every boss dies.
henesys._opening: Tier C: owner choice #241: t0 rate 0.25/cap 6, t120 0.55/11, t180 0.75/15; t240 onward and pools unchanged.

ellinia._bosses: Tier C (spec #447, ticket #452): no boss appears twice across the progression, so Ellinia takes the Mushroom Castle bosses and Faust: Prime Minister replaces Stumpy, Grey Yeti and King Pepe replaces King Slime, Faust replaces Dyle. Each matches the boss it replaces by the #254 method (effective HP, contact and attack damage at the slot's typical_hp/typical_pdd); the _tier notes show the derivations. Starting values, untuned. Canonical stats, attack boxes, timing and skill kits remain in Mob.wz.

Each boss time is relative to map entry. 101010100 The Tree That Grew I: Prime Minister (a Mushroom Castle boss; the map has no v83 boss of its own); 100040100 The Forest of Wisdom: Grey Yeti and King Pepe; 100040105 The Forest of Evil I: Faust (its own MonsterBook map).

MobSkill 200/165 (Helmet Pepe 3300003 and Royal Guard Pepe 3300004, limit 200, every 40 s from 80% HP) stays canonical through StageRoster

tier C (#452, method of #254): Faust takes Dyle's slot, so it matches the replaced boss at the same typical_hp/typical_pdd: 9800 x 0.8224 = 8060 HP (Dyle 31000 x 0.26); touch 165 x 1.32 = 179..211 of 424 HP (Dyle touch 190 x 1.14 = 178..211); attack1 (a type 2 ball) 190 x 1.14 = 178..211 (Dyle has no attack, so it matches Dyle's touch, as King Slime's slam matches Mano's), 8 s cadence. Canonical kit unchanged: heal114 (x3000, from 90% HP, every 10 s), buffs 110/112/113, summon 200/84 (up to 15 Zombie Lupin, every 10 s from 80% HP) and immunity140 (10 s every 30 s)

perion._tier: Tier A: map IDs and original_life from v83 Map.wz. Tier C (owner, spec #253): region, map order, boss picks and pool rules; the numeric curve (keyframe rate/max_alive/hp/speed, bursts, elites, exp_mult, hard_cap, post_duration_slope) copies Henesys exactly. The 210 s keyframe is Henesys's curve interpolated at 3:30 (rate 0.875, max_alive 17.5, speed 1.0375), added only to carry the 3:30 pool change; keyframes from 300 s carry no pool because map 1 picks only keyframes with t < 300 (maps 2 and 3 use their own life lists).
perion.name: West Street Corner of Perion
perion._bosses: Tier C (spec #253, starting values, untuned): each boss matches the Henesys boss of the same map slot (Mano, Mushmom, Blue Mushmom) at that slot's typical_hp/typical_pdd: survivor HP = round(canonical maxHP x hp_mult) equals the slot's, and hp_mult/dmg_mult/attack_dmg_mult are the 0.01 steps whose 85-100% roll range (CombatMath.monster_damage) lies closest to the slot's touch/attack roll range. Canonical PDD/MDD, level and undead flags are not normalized. Spec #447 (ticket #452): no boss appears twice across the progression, so map 1 is King Clang (shell 5220001, final form 5220000) instead of Mano, who stays in Henesys; maps 2 and 3 keep Stumpy and Iron Hook.
perion._maps: Tier C: owner map order and pool rules, spec #253. Map 1 is a hand-written curve pool of its own life mobs; maps 2 and 3 use their v83 life lists (no timed or hidden entries in v83). Bosses per spec #447 (ticket #452): 102010000 West Street Corner of Perion: King Clang (the last unused Victoria field boss; its Hot Sand map is not in the game, so the shell and its final form fight here); 101030404 East Rocky Mountain V: Stumpy (its own map); 106000101: Iron Hook.

boss._tier: tier C (#452, method of #254): King Clang takes Mano's slot (Mano now only guards Henesys), so it matches Mano at the same typical_hp/typical_pdd. The encounter is the 5220001 shell (4000 HP, stands, never attacks) that revives into 5220000 (25000 HP) at its death position (#456): effective HP 4000 x 0.1 = 400 for the shell plus 25000 x 0.128 = 3200 for the form = 3600 (Mano 2000 x 1.8). Touch 165 x 0.61 = 83..98 of 196 HP (shell and form share PADamage 165; Mano touch 90 x 1.15 = 82..98); the form's attack1 (type 0 strike, PADamage 180) x 0.56 = 83..98 (Mano has no attack, so it matches Mano's touch, as King Slime's slam does in Kerning), 8 s cadence. Canonical kit unchanged: stun123 (2 s, every 15 s, 60%), summon 200/82 (Lorang and Clang, limit 30, every 10 s from 80% HP), buffs 110/112/113 and heal114 (x700, from 80% HP, every 30 s). The fight is won only on 5220000

All stack on existing scales. Training seeds 1/2/2026 only. Boss HP/contact/attack capture the ramp at actual arrival; ordinary damage follows current time.
